LOOK: Traffic enforcers apprehend motorists for violations along Legarda Street in Manila on Sunday, Jan. 11.

Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez ordered the Land Transportation Office (LTO) to stop confiscating drivers’ licenses during apprehensions and instead place them under alert status, while extending the period for motorists to settle their traffic violations.

📸: John Louie Abrina/MB
